in_marathi.name: Vidyadhari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bearer of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vidyadhari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name from Hindu mythology, Vidyadhari signifies a celestial being who is the bearer of knowledge and wisdom.

in_bengali.name: Vidyadhari
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Bearer of Knowledge
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vidyadhari একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name from Hindu mythology, Vidyadhari signifies a celestial being who is the bearer of knowledge and wisdom.
